children.label: c
children.prompt: How many people have a handspan less than 23 cm wide?

answer.worked: The classes $17\text{–}19$ and $20\text{–}22$ contain all handspans below $23$ cm. There are $6+5=11$ people.

children.label: d
children.prompt: What information has been lost due to the grouping?

answer.short: Individual handspan values and their frequencies.
answer.worked: The grouped table gives only the number of people in each class. It no longer shows how many people have each exact handspan.
